title: Stephen Dick's early suggestion that the phenomenon is AI

tellings.quote: more than 20 years ago he suggested that these were uh AI a form of AI or that if we met them they would be a form of AI

plain: More than twenty years ago, the science historian Steven J. Dick suggested that the beings behind UFO sightings might be a form of artificial intelligence, or that if we ever met them, they would turn out to be one. Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFO belief, credits him with the idea, mentioning him alongside the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, to show the AI explanation is older than it seems.
